title: THE STASH SPEAKS CONTROLLER ON A CONTROLLER
why: Seen on the 4K controller screenshot of 2026-10-08: on a controller (player 2 in co-op) the stash still listed the mouse and keyboard moves (DRAG, RIGHT CLICK, SHIFT, CTRL, ALT, 1-9). With a pad on, it now shows the pad row instead: D-PAD moves the highlight, A picks up and A again places (v16.79), Y opens all actions (v18.27), B backs out.
now: On a controller the stash shows the controller buttons.
